kubernetes:
# Duckdns: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-duckdns/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - network: host networking is required; hostNetwork is set and no Service is emitted.
#   - readOnlyRootFilesystem is supported by this image; enable it once /config and /tmp are mounted.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: duckdns-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: duckdns
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
  SUBDOMAINS: subdomain1,subdomain2
  TOKEN: token
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: duckdns
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: duckdns
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: duckdns
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: duckdns
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: duckdns
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/duckdns:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: duckdns-env
      hostNetwork: true
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
quadlet:
# duckdns.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-duckdns/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Duckdns (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/duckdns:latest
ContainerName=duckdns
AutoUpdate=registry
# Network=host
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Environment=SUBDOMAINS=subdomain1,subdomain2
Environment=TOKEN=token
# Environment=UPDATE_IP=ipv4
# Environment=LOG_FILE=false
# Volume=/path/to/duckdns/config:/config:Z

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
